payload.entry:
LAND AUDIT: Read this epic and all four child beads, including every note. Reviewed sase-core commits 96d5b67b (grammar), c089cf17 (payload/digest/resolve), df735e42 (quote), 88d63855 (sheet), and actual validator, decisions modules, PyO3 wrappers and tests against plan:202610/core_plan_decisions.md and outer Section 6.1. All seven bindings are registered; schema stays v3 and legacy parity is retained. Remaining epic work: (1) grammar.rs counts warnings as errors when deciding whether to append the decision wire: ask without ? is warning-only/ok but the decision disappears; (2) Archived completeness ignores a decided_via-only stamp and returns before completeness for absent/empty decisions; (3) memory_note_on_line slices the four preceding bytes without checking a UTF-8 boundary; a rustc probe importing the exact current callout.rs confirms that ordinary body text `Update 🚀 sase/memory/tui.md.` panics at line 254; (4) visible_lines drops fences, so callout spans cross the non-blockquote boundary: probe header/tail/fenced code/ordinary quote ends at line 13 instead of 9; (5) sheet.rs check_sheet_row accepts unknown nonblank memory provenance, contradicting the usage-error contract, and malformed inherited row validation is incomplete; (6) auto emits skipped-memory follow-ups for every off row instead of only unrequested rows; (7) grammar tests lack the required specific archive source refs and .1 note #2 reports counts but no artifact list, so make the 20-plan tuning evidence auditable. These are remaining epic work, not follow-up tasks. Preparing a single medium landing tale.
INTEGRATION: Core current HEAD/origin/master is 9ea87c11. Only non-epic commit after first epic implementation commit is 9ea87c11: wait default flip/metadata, no Plan Decisions caller or duplicate; 4d5cf650 after epic creation is isolated bead read-model groundwork. Primary drift since epic creation is 2268f50d79, 69a4431521, 3df340f909 (sibling .2 human-authorship gatherer), 5a3f8ae574, 3a4178b15a, and 2f4d5f9bb0: provenance gatherer records source/ref/text compatible with quote input; remaining diffs are artifacts, waits, scheduler, and test splits. No caller integration belongs to this child: outer gate phase owns new calls and core revision pin.
FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: .1#1, .2#1, .3#1, .4#1 all propose the same two stale wait-keyword matrix expectations. Applied /sase_new_task: CI-specific and all-type searches plus both last-week sweeps found no task duplicate; reviewed active causal epic sase-1h7 and child .3. Core commit 21c539fd (sase-1h7.3) added for_epic to WAIT_KEYWORDS while both matrix expectations remain six keys. Routed all four proposals as one DISCOVERED ISSUE on still-open sase-1h7 with exact files/tests and clean-base evidence from the proposing beads. No task created; no proposals discarded. Current epic and parent phase sase-1hi.1 have no epic-symbol entries. They remain open until the repair tale completes verification and normal closeout; never force a successful nested landing.
